chain.label: Glider departs controlled flight while thermalling
chain.trigger: the accident glider was in a tight turn, as if climbing in a thermal, when it entered the spiral

chain.label: Pilot extends airbrakes during high-speed descent
chain.trigger: the pilot extended the airbrakes at some point in an attempt to slow the glider during the descent prior to the breakup

caused_by.evidence: the speed quickly built up as the glider completed two full rotations... nose pitched further down to a near-vertical attitude

chain.label: Wings overloaded during high-speed pull-up
chain.trigger: the wings bending upward and the wing tips coning higher; wing deflection reached 45 degrees or more before the wings failed

caused_by.evidence: airbrakes function like spoilers and have the effect of shifting the aerodynamic loads outboard on the wings...causes an increased lift outside of the airbrake range
the glider would accelerate from Vs to Vne in 8.6 seconds, with an additional 1.8 seconds to accelerate from Vne to Vd

chain.label: Wing spar and skin fail in overload
chain.trigger: All the wing failures were overload in character and occurred at loadings well above the ultimate design load limits

caused_by.evidence: the left and right outboard wing sections failed symmetrically at two locations

chain.label: Wings disintegrate in flight
chain.trigger: the outboard wing tip panels departed from the glider, the wings disintegrated

caused_by.evidence: the outboard wing tip panels departed from the glider, and the wings disintegrated

chain.label: Fuselage impacts terrain
chain.trigger: the fuselage dove into the ground

caused_by.evidence: the fuselage dove into the ground

chain.label: Pilot and passenger fatally injured
chain.trigger: The commercial glider pilot and a passenger were fatally injured

caused_by.evidence: the pilot and passenger were fatally injured, and the glider was destroyed
